div.head: I Cn 19
div.ab: Ac gehwylc Cristen man do, swa him þearf is: gime his Cristendomes georne ⁊ gearwige hine eac to huselgange huru þriwa [on geare gehwa hine sylfne], þe his agene þearfe wylle understandan, swa swa him þearf sig.

Gehwylc Cristen man dó, swa him ðearf is: gyme his Cristendom georne ⁊ gearwie hine eac to huselgange huru ðriwa on geare gehwá hine sylfne, ðe ðe his agene ðearfe wille understandan, swa swa heom ðearf si.

Ac æghwilc Cristen man do, swa him þearf is: gime his Cristendomes á georne and gearwige hine eac to huselgange huru þriwa on geare gehwa hine sylfne, þe his agene þearfe wylle understanden, swa swa him þearf sy.

Quicumque Christianus, sicut uere necessarium est, dignam Christianitati suę curam inpendat et ad perceptionem communionis Dominicę ter saltem in anno se preparet, ut non hoc ad iudicium, sed ad remedium salutare manducet.
[19] Faciamus etiam, sicut nobis expedit: preparemus nosmet ipsos et tales nos exhibeamus, ut saltem ter in anno possimus communicari corporis et sanguinis Domini.

Itaque omnis Christianus quod sibi expediat faciat: Christianitatem suam diligenter custodiat, ad eucaristie percepcionem saltim ter in anno se ipsum preparet, quicumque propriam utilitatem, ueluti sibi expedit, considerare uoluerit.

Gehwylc Cristen man dó, swa him ðearf is: gyme his Cristendom georne ⁊ gearwie hine eac to huselgange huru ðriwa on geare gehwá hine sylfne [s]e ðe his agene ðearfe wille understandan, swa swa heom ðearf si.

Ac gehwylc Cristen man do swa him þearf is: gime his Cristendomes georne and gearwige hine eac to huselgange huru þriwa on geare gehwa hine sylfne þe his agene þearfe wylle understandan, swa swa him þearf sig.

Vielmehr jeder Christenmensch handle, wie ihm noth thut: er achte seines Christenthums (stets A) gewissenhaft, und bereite sich auch jeder vor zum Abendmahl wenigstens dreimal im Jahre, wer seinen eigenen Nutzen verstehen will, so wie ihm noth thut.

But let every Christian man do what he needs to: take (ever, A) eager care of his Christianity, and let each who will understand his own good prepare himself to go to communion at least three times a year, as he needs to.

Every Christian man shall do as is his duty: he shall pay zealous regard to his Christian profession and shall likewise prepare himself for the sacrament at least three times a year, if he seeks to understand, as he ought, what is for his own good.

But let each Christian do that which is required of him: attend diligently to his Christian faith and likewise prepare himself to receive the sacrament at least three times during the year if he wishes to understand his responsibilities, just as he should.

div.note: In G, ‘on geare gehwa hine sylfne’ was written over an erasure in the 16th century. Quadr. adds ‘ut non … ad iudicium’ (1 Cor. 11:29). Liebermann compares VI Atr 27, 27.1.; Robertson (p. 139) takes I Cn from B, which begins at ‘mæssedæg’ in 14.2, the earlier clauses being supplied from G; BR: added from Gesetze I p. 301, October 2026 (MS Cons)
